subject: general
question: Which of the following Central Sector Scheme launched in February 2022 aims to provide welfare measures to the transgender and people engaged in acts of begging?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SMILE**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SMILE** (Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise) is a **Central Sector Scheme** launched in** February 2022**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide welfare measures to the **transgender community **and people engaged in acts of begging.
 
• It includes comprehensive measures for their rehabilitation, medical care, counseling, education, skill development, and economic linkages.
 
• The scheme is designed to ensure that these marginalized groups are brought into the mainstream and can live with dignity and respect.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment** is the nodal ministry for the implementation of the SMILE scheme.
 
• It is part of the government's broader vision to provide social security and inclusion to the most vulnerable sections of society.
 
• Other initiatives under the ministry also focus on the welfare of senior citizens, persons with disabilities, and other disadvantaged groups.
